description: This file contains implementation code for rewriting atomic counters in shader translation, including functions and classes for handling atomic counter buffers, their declarations, and transformations within an AST traversal.

classes.name: RewriteAtomicCountersTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser class that rewrites atomic counter variables and function calls to emulate atomic counters using storage buffers.

methods.name: DeclareAtomicCountersBuffers
methods.description: Adds a storage buffer array for atomic counters in the shader's AST.

methods.name: CreateUIntConstant
methods.description: Creates a constant node representing an unsigned integer value.

methods.name: CreateAtomicCounterConstant
methods.description: Creates a constructor node for an atomic counter with specified binding and offset.

methods.name: CreateAtomicCounterRef
methods.description: Generates a reference to an atomic counter element within the storage buffer based on binding and offset.

methods.name: RewriteAtomicCounters
methods.description: Main function that applies the atomic counters rewriting pass on the AST.
